title: Hyperbolic two-sided bounds for the Kilbas–Saigo function
statement:
Let $\alpha\in(0,1]$, $m>0$, $l>m-1/\alpha$, and $x\geq 0$. Let $E_{\alpha,m,l}$ be the Kilbas–Saigo function. **The conjectured two-sided bound.** One has

$$
\frac{1}{1+\frac{{\Gamma}(1+\alpha(l-m))}{{\Gamma}(1+\alpha(l-m+1))}x}\leq E_{\alpha,m,l}(-x)\leq \frac{1}{1+\frac{{\Gamma}(1+\alpha l)}{{\Gamma}(1+\alpha(1+l))}x}.
$$

The bounds are natural because the constants match the small- and large-$x$ asymptotic regimes. The source states that the conjecture is known when $l=m-1$ and when $m=1$, while the general case remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.05666

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2020).
source_name: Lotfi Boudabsa and Thomas Simon, “Some properties of the Kilbas-Saigo function”, arXiv:2012.05666 (2020).
